The writer's half: every asset type stamps its schema number AND the engine
that wrote it, UE's package summary in miniature. Scenes and prefabs add the
plugin versions on top (FContentVersionStamp, in Game).

free.name: CheckMdfSchemaVersionFromKey
free.signature: EMdfSchemaCompat CheckMdfSchemaVersionFromKey(const MdfNode& root, const char* versionKey, uint32_t supported, const char* label, const char* assetName = "", uint32_t* outStored = nullptr)
free.doc:
Reads `schema_version` off an asset's root node and reports it against the
version this build supports. An absent marker means 1: the pre-versioning
baseline every early file has.

Why this exists: roughly twenty-five asset types STAMPED a schema version
and no reader ever looked at it, two of them having already bumped to v2.
A file from a newer engine therefore loaded through the lenient MDF reader,
which drops what it does not recognise — so the asset came up quietly
wrong, and re-saving it wrote the loss back to disk. `Newer` is the case
that matters, and a caller must act on it — the warning alone protects
nothing. An asset loader refuses the file (UE's rule: an older engine does
not open a newer asset). A loader that must open the file anyway — a scene
or prefab shown read-only — refuses to SAVE over it instead. Only a file
whose refusal would itself lose data, like player settings that would
otherwise reset to defaults and be written back, keeps what it recognises.

`label` names the type in the log line ("Quest", "SoundCue", ...).
`outStored` receives the version actually found, for a caller that wants to
drive its own migration chain.

A root that also carries `engine_version` (FMdfSchemaStamp::Stamp) reads as
Newer when that engine is newer than this one even at the same schema
number — a newer build adds fields and enumerators without bumping every
asset type's schema, and the number alone let such a file through. A file
whose schema is Older still reports Older, so its migration runs.

free.name: CheckMdfSchemaVersion
free.signature: inline EMdfSchemaCompat CheckMdfSchemaVersion(const MdfNode& root, uint32_t supported, const char* label, const char* assetName = "", uint32_t* outStored = nullptr)
free.doc: The common case: the marker is called `schema_version`.
